question:
Which of the following options should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?

14 15 18 23 30 ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic**: **Addition of odd number in the series.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4bed5193c22088159545521318da60ee37d2b6bc30735a832c458024f4ce161.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebc3ec8254e3bf1d59db5ad5f5966b16a11174fcd2080c5145d10c0f049a5f76.png] 

Thus, **39 is next number in this series.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
